commit_message: Agent Core v0.2.15 stage 3: test truncated reviewer recovery

edits.new:
@needs_shell
    def test_review_length_retry_reuses_full_context_with_larger_budget(self):
        root, workspace, state, logger, sources = self.make_runtime()
        reviewer = ScriptedClient(
            [
                '{"verdict":"PASS","summary":"abgeschnitten"',
                json.dumps({
                    "verdict": "PASS",
                    "summary": "Vollständig nach größerem Ausgabelimit.",
                    "issues": [],
                }),
            ],
            finish_reasons=["length", "stop"],
        )
        controller = AgentController(
            ScriptedClient([]),
            state,
            logger,
            sources,
            reviewer_client=reviewer,
        )
        messages = [
            {"role": "system", "content": "REVIEW SYSTEM"},
            {"role": "user", "content": "ORIGINALAUFTRAG und FINALER DIFF"},
        ]

        parsed = controller._review_json_call(
            messages,
            1800,
            stage="acceptance_review",
        )

        self.assertEqual(parsed["verdict"], "PASS")
        self.assertEqual(len(reviewer.requests), 2)
        self.assertEqual(reviewer.max_tokens_requests[0], 1800)
        self.assertGreater(reviewer.max_tokens_requests[1], 1800)
        self.assertEqual(prompt_text(reviewer.requests[0]), prompt_text(reviewer.requests[1]))
        self.assertNotIn("ausschließlich das Ausgabeformat", prompt_text(reviewer.requests[1]))

        events = (root / "events.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertIn("REVIEW_OUTPUT_TRUNCATED", events)
        self.assertIn("größerem Ausgabelimit", events)

    @needs_shell
    def test_review_second_length_failure_raises_truncated_without_format_repair(self):
        root, workspace, state, logger, sources = self.make_runtime()
        reviewer = ScriptedClient(
            [
                '{"verdict":"PASS","summary":"abgeschnitten"',
                '{"verdict":"PASS","summary":"immer noch abgeschnitten"',
            ],
            finish_reasons=["length", "length"],
        )
        controller = AgentController(
            ScriptedClient([]),
            state,
            logger,
            sources,
            reviewer_client=reviewer,
        )

        with self.assertRaises(AgentError) as ctx:
            controller._review_json_call(
                [
                    {"role": "system", "content": "REVIEW SYSTEM"},
                    {"role": "user", "content": "ORIGINALAUFTRAG und FINALER DIFF"},
                ],
                1800,
                stage="acceptance_review",
            )

        self.assertIn("REVIEW_OUTPUT_TRUNCATED", str(ctx.exception))
        self.assertEqual(len(reviewer.requests), 2)
        self.assertTrue(all(
            "ausschließlich das Ausgabeformat" not in prompt_text(request)
            for request in reviewer.requests
        ))

    @needs_shell
    def test_independent_reviewer_invalid_after_repair_raises_typed_error(self):

self.assertIn("ausführbaren/erreichbaren Pfad", prompt_text(reviewer.requests[2]))
        self.assertIn("höchstens 180 Zeichen", prompt_text(reviewer.requests[2]))
